examples.en: Our team won the game.
He plays for the school team.

mnemonic.tip: team 谐音"梯姆"——一队人像搭梯子一样彼此配合、齐心协力。

examples.en: We watched a tennis match.
examples.zh: 我们看了一场网球比赛。

examples.en: The match ended in a draw.

mnemonic.tip: match 有"相配"义,两支势均力敌的队配到一起较量就是一场 match。

examples.en: The final score was 2-1.
He scored the winning goal.

mnemonic.tip: score 谐音"斯扣儿"——每进一球就在记分牌上"扣"上一分。

examples.en: He scored two goals today.
My goal is to run faster.

mnemonic.tip: 球踢进 goal(球门)就得分,人生也要瞄准自己的 goal(目标)。

examples.en: She is the best player on the team.
Each team has eleven players.

mnemonic.tip: play(玩/打球)+er(人),下场打球的人就是球员。

examples.en: The coach trains the team every day.
We took a coach to the city.
examples.zh: 我们坐长途客车去了城里。

mnemonic.tip: coach 既是"教练"又是"长途车"——教练像车一样把队员"载"向胜利。

examples.en: The referee blew his whistle.
The referee gave a red card.

mnemonic.tip: refer(参照/裁定)+ee(人),球场上说了算、做裁定的人就是裁判。

examples.en: She is the world champion.
Our team became champions.

mnemonic.tip: champion 谐音"掌拼"——凭真本事掌握全场、拼到第一就是冠军。

examples.en: She won first place in the competition.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中得了第一名。

examples.en: There is strong competition for the job.

mnemonic.tip: com(共同)+pet(追求,同 petition)+ition,大家一起追同一个目标就是竞争/比赛。

examples.en: He won the 100-metre race.
The two boys raced to the gate.
examples.zh: 两个男孩赛跑到大门口。

mnemonic.tip: race 谐音"瑞斯"不如记"来死"反着想——赛跑拼到底,谁快谁赢。

examples.en: Our team beat theirs 3-0.
Nobody can beat him at chess.

mnemonic.tip: beat 本义"敲打",把对手打得抬不起头就是击败(过去式还是 beat)。

examples.en: They defeated the strongest team.
examples.zh: 他们击败了最强的队伍。

examples.en: The team suffered a defeat.
examples.zh: 这支队伍遭遇了一场失败。

mnemonic.tip: de(向下)+feat(做/成就),把对方的气势"往下"打压就是击败。

examples.en: The players train every morning.
She trains hard for the race.

mnemonic.tip: train 也是"火车",训练就像开火车,一节节反复地把本领拉起来。

examples.en: I go to the gym three times a week.
We play basketball in the gym.

mnemonic.tip: gym 是 gymnasium 的缩写,举铁流汗练身材的地方。

examples.en: The stadium holds fifty thousand people.
examples.zh: 这座体育场能容纳五万人。

examples.en: Fans filled the stadium.

mnemonic.tip: stadium 谐音"斯泰迪姆"——万人"堆"在一起看比赛的大场子。

examples.en: She won a gold medal.
He proudly showed his medal.

mnemonic.tip: medal 谐音"美倒"——一枚奖牌美得让人倾倒。

examples.en: The winner got a big prize.
examples.zh: 获胜者得到了一份大奖。

examples.en: First prize is a new bike.
examples.zh: 一等奖是一辆新自行车。

mnemonic.tip: prize 谐音"派子"——赢了就给你派个奖。

examples.en: He is a big football fan.
The fans cheered loudly.

mnemonic.tip: fan 是"风扇",球迷为主队摇旗呐喊,像风扇一样呼呼扇起气氛。

examples.en: He kicked the ball into the net.
Don't kick the door!

mnemonic.tip: kick 谐音"凯克"——起脚就是"咔"地一"踢"。

examples.en: Throw the ball to me.
She threw the ball over the wall.

mnemonic.tip: throw 里有 row(划),手臂像划桨一样甩出去就是投掷(过去式 threw)。

examples.en: Can you catch the ball?
The dog caught the stick.

mnemonic.tip: catch 谐音"卡吃"——球飞来"卡"进手心,一把"吃"下就是接住。

examples.en: He can jump very high.
The cat jumped onto the table.

mnemonic.tip: jump 的 j 像人屈膝、mp 像双脚蹬地弹起,一看就是跳。

examples.en: I cycle to school every day.
They cycled around the lake.

mnemonic.tip: cycl(圈,同 circle)+e,车轮转圈前进就是骑车。

examples.en: She jogs in the park each morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上在公园慢跑。

examples.en: Jogging is good for your heart.

mnemonic.tip: jog 谐音"轧"——脚步不紧不慢地"轧"过地面就是慢跑。

examples.en: We skate on the frozen lake.
examples.zh: 我们在结冰的湖面上滑冰。

examples.en: He learned to skate at six.

mnemonic.tip: skate 谐音"斯给它"——冰刀"嘶"地划过冰面就是滑冰。

examples.en: They ski in the mountains in winter.
I want to learn to ski.

mnemonic.tip: ski 长得像两根雪橇板,踩上去从雪坡"嘶"地滑下来。

examples.en: Can you swim across the pool?
We swim in the sea in summer.

mnemonic.tip: swim 里的 w 像水波,身体在水波里划动就是游泳(过去式 swam)。

examples.en: They play tennis on Sundays.
She is good at tennis.

mnemonic.tip: tennis 谐音"太累事"——追着小球满场跑,确实是件累人的运动。

examples.en: We play volleyball on the beach.
Volleyball needs six players.

mnemonic.tip: volley(凌空击球)+ball(球),球不落地凌空对打就是排球。

examples.en: Our opponent is a strong team.
He shook hands with his opponent.

mnemonic.tip: op(相对)+pon(放,同 position的pon)+ent,站在你对面的人就是对手。

examples.en: The referee blew the whistle.
He whistled a happy tune.

mnemonic.tip: whistle 里的 whis 像"嘘"的气声,t 不发音,吹出"嘘——"就是哨声。

examples.en: Always warm up before you run.
The players warmed up on the field.

mnemonic.tip: warm(变暖)+up,运动前先把身体活动"热"起来就是热身。

examples.en: Lifting weights builds strength.
He pushed the door with all his strength.

mnemonic.tip: strong(强壮)的名词形式 strength,强壮带来的就是力量。

examples.en: I hope we win the game.
She won the first prize.

mnemonic.tip: win 里有 W,像举起双臂庆祝胜利的手势。

examples.en: Nobody likes to lose.
Don't lose your ticket.

mnemonic.tip: lose(输/丢)只有一个 o,loose(松的)有两个 o,别把它"丢"错。

examples.en: The athlete ran very fast.
examples.zh: 这名运动员跑得非常快。

examples.en: Athletes need to train hard.

mnemonic.tip: athlete 谐音"爱思利特"——运动员爱思考、身手利落又特别能拼。

examples.en: They booked a tennis court.
The players ran onto the court.

mnemonic.tip: court 也指"法庭",网球场和法庭一样都有清楚的界线规则。

examples.en: After the match he was exhausted.
I feel exhausted after training.

mnemonic.tip: ex(向外)+haust(汲取,同 exhaust),体力被全部抽干就是筋疲力尽。

examples.en: We play badminton in the park on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我们周日在公园打羽毛球。

examples.en: Badminton is very popular in China.

mnemonic.tip: 得名于英国 Badminton 庄园——在那里第一次流行起来。

examples.en: Baseball is the national sport of Japan and the USA.
examples.zh: 棒球是日本和美国的国民运动。

examples.en: He wears his baseball cap everywhere.
examples.zh: 他到哪儿都戴着棒球帽。

mnemonic.tip: base(垒)+ball(球)→绕着垒跑的球类→棒球。

examples.en: Grandpa plays golf every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 爷爷每周六上午打高尔夫。

examples.en: A golf ball is small and hard.

mnemonic.tip: golf 谐音"高尔夫"——音译词。

examples.en: Rugby players pass the ball backwards.
examples.zh: 橄榄球运动员向后传球。

examples.en: He broke his nose playing rugby.
examples.zh: 他打橄榄球摔断了鼻梁。

mnemonic.tip: 得名于英国 Rugby 学校——一个学生抱起足球跑，新运动诞生。

examples.en: Cricket matches can last a whole day.
We heard crickets singing in the grass.
examples.zh: 我们听见草丛里蟋蟀在叫。

mnemonic.tip: 一词两义：英国人的 cricket 板球，草丛里的 cricket 蟋蟀。

examples.en: Ice hockey is fast and exciting.
examples.zh: 冰球比赛节奏快又刺激。

examples.en: She plays hockey for the school team.

mnemonic.tip: hockey 谐音"呼气"——满场跑得直呼气。

examples.en: Boxing needs quick hands and quick feet.
The boxing match ended in the third round.
examples.zh: 拳击赛在第三回合结束。

mnemonic.tip: box(击打)+ing→用拳头打的运动→拳击。

examples.en: She practises gymnastics three times a week.
Gymnastics makes your body strong and flexible.
examples.zh: 体操让身体强壮又柔韧。

mnemonic.tip: gym(体育馆)+nastics→在体育馆里练的技巧运动→体操。

examples.en: The school athletics day is in May.
examples.zh: 学校田径运动会在五月。

examples.en: Running and jumping are athletics events.

mnemonic.tip: athlete(运动员)+ics→运动员的基本功——田径。

examples.en: Thousands of runners joined the city marathon.
examples.zh: 数千名跑者参加了城市马拉松。

examples.en: Finishing a marathon takes months of training.
examples.zh: 跑完马拉松需要数月训练。

mnemonic.tip: 源自希腊 Marathon 平原——士兵跑回雅典报捷的距离。

examples.en: He goes surfing whenever the waves are good.
examples.zh: 浪好的时候他就去冲浪。

examples.en: Surfing looks easy but is hard to learn.

mnemonic.tip: surf(浪)+ing→踩着浪走→冲浪；上网也叫 surf the Internet。

examples.en: China wins many gold medals in diving.
examples.zh: 中国在跳水项目上拿了很多金牌。

examples.en: We tried diving to see the fish under the sea.
examples.zh: 我们尝试潜水看海底的鱼。

mnemonic.tip: dive(跳入水)+ing→跳水/潜水。

examples.en: Rowing uses almost every muscle in your body.
examples.zh: 划船几乎用到全身肌肉。

examples.en: The rowing team trains on the river at dawn.
examples.zh: 赛艇队清晨在河上训练。

mnemonic.tip: row(划)+ing——注意读 /rəʊ/，与 row(一排)同形。

examples.en: Rock climbing tests both strength and courage.
They went climbing in the mountains last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天他们去山里登山了。

mnemonic.tip: climb(爬)+ing→攀爬运动；b 不发音。

examples.en: Table tennis is China’s strongest sport.
examples.zh: 乒乓球是中国最强的运动项目。

examples.en: They played table tennis after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后他们打了乒乓球。

mnemonic.tip: table(桌)+tennis(网球)→桌上的网球→乒乓球。

examples.en: Mum does yoga to relax before bed.
Yoga improves your balance and breathing.
examples.zh: 瑜伽能改善平衡和呼吸。

mnemonic.tip: yoga 音译"瑜伽"——来自印度的古老运动。

examples.en: The players ran onto the pitch.
The football pitch was muddy after the rain.

mnemonic.tip: 英式足球场叫 pitch，网球篮球场叫 court。

examples.en: The runners lined up on the track.
examples.zh: 赛跑选手在跑道上列队。

examples.en: The train left the track in the film.

mnemonic.tip: 田径场一圈圈的 track 跑道；track and field 田径。

examples.en: The goalkeeper wears special gloves.
Put on gloves; it is freezing outside.

mnemonic.tip: g+love：把爱(love)戴在手上——手套。

examples.en: Don’t forget your PE kit tomorrow.
The team’s new kit is red and white.
examples.zh: 球队的新队服是红白色的。

mnemonic.tip: 英式说法：PE kit 体育课装备，football kit 球衣套装。

examples.en: The scoreboard showed 3–2 at half-time.
All eyes turned to the scoreboard.
examples.zh: 所有目光都投向记分牌。

mnemonic.tip: score(比分)+board(牌)→显示比分的牌。

examples.en: The goalkeeper saved a penalty in the last minute.
examples.zh: 守门员在最后一分钟扑出点球。

examples.en: A goalkeeper must stay calm under pressure.
examples.zh: 守门员要在压力下保持冷静。

mnemonic.tip: goal(球门)+keeper(看守者)→守住球门的人。

examples.en: Thirty-two teams entered the tournament.
examples.zh: 三十二支队伍参加了锦标赛。

examples.en: She won her first tennis tournament at fifteen.
examples.zh: 她十五岁赢得首个网球锦标赛。

mnemonic.tip: 中世纪骑士的比武大会就叫 tournament——轮番上阵。

examples.en: Our school team plays in the city league.
The team is top of the league this season.
examples.zh: 这支球队本赛季联赛排名第一。

mnemonic.tip: league 谐音"力搿"——各队合力搿在一起打联赛。

examples.en: They reached the final for the first time.
The final will be played on Saturday.

mnemonic.tip: fin(结束)+al→最后一场→决赛；finish 同根。

examples.en: The swimming championship is held every year.
They won the national championship twice.
examples.zh: 他们两次夺得全国冠军。

mnemonic.tip: champion(冠军)+ship→争夺冠军的比赛。

examples.en: The fans celebrated the victory all night.
It was an easy victory for the home team.

mnemonic.tip: V 字手势就是 victory——胜利的 V。

examples.en: She broke the school record for the 100 metres.
examples.zh: 她打破了学校百米纪录。

examples.en: The world record is hard to beat.

mnemonic.tip: break a record 破纪录——record 名词重音在前，动词在后。

examples.en: The long jump is my favourite event.
examples.zh: 跳远是我最喜欢的项目。

examples.en: The school sports day is a big event.

mnemonic.tip: e(出)+vent(来)→发生出来的事→事件/项目。

examples.en: Pass the ball to your teammates.
She gets on well with all her teammates.
examples.zh: 她和所有队友都相处融洽。

mnemonic.tip: team(队)+mate(伙伴)→同队的伙伴→队友。

examples.en: Thousands of supporters travelled to the away game.
The supporters sang for the whole match.

mnemonic.tip: support(支持)+er(人)→支持球队的人。

examples.en: Fifty thousand spectators filled the stadium.
examples.zh: 五万名观众坐满体育场。

examples.en: Spectators must stay behind the line.

mnemonic.tip: spect(看)+ator(人)→到场观看的人。

examples.en: The crowd cheered when she crossed the line.
examples.zh: 她冲线时人群欢呼起来。

examples.en: We went to cheer for our class team.

mnemonic.tip: cheer 谐音"切尔"——切尔西球迷最会 cheer。

examples.en: The referee gave a penalty in the last minute.
examples.zh: 裁判在最后一分钟判了点球。

examples.en: There is a penalty for handball.

mnemonic.tip: penal(惩罚)+ty→犯规的代价→点球/处罚。

examples.en: That push was clearly a foul.
He was sent off after his fifth foul.
examples.zh: 第五次犯规后他被罚下场。

mnemonic.tip: foul 与 fool(傻瓜)音近——傻傻犯规就丢分。

examples.en: The match ended in a two-all draw.
examples.zh: 比赛以二比二平局结束。

examples.en: A draw felt like a defeat for the stronger team.
examples.zh: 对更强的一方来说，平局如同失利。

mnemonic.tip: 一词多义：draw 画画、平局、抽签——比分拉平叫 draw。

examples.en: A good loser congratulates the winner.
examples.zh: 输得起的人会祝贺胜者。

examples.en: There are no losers when you try your best.
examples.zh: 尽了全力就没有失败者。

mnemonic.tip: lose(输)+er(人)→输的一方。

examples.en: Teams from ten schools competed in the relay.
examples.zh: 十所学校的队伍参加了接力赛。

examples.en: She will compete against last year’s champion.

mnemonic.tip: com(共同)+pete(追求)→一起争夺→竞争；名词 competition。

examples.en: The ball bounced twice before the net.
Children love bouncing on the trampoline.
examples.zh: 孩子们爱在蹦床上蹦跳。

mnemonic.tip: bounce 谐音"棒次"——球棒一击，球嘭嘭弹起。

examples.en: She dived into the pool without a splash.
examples.zh: 她入水时几乎没有水花。

examples.en: The keeper dived to save the shot.

mnemonic.tip: dive 的 d 像人弯腰俯冲的侧影——头朝下扎进水里。

examples.en: Always stretch before you run.
The cat stretched and went back to sleep.

mnemonic.tip: stretch 音里带"拉扯"感——s-t-r 一路拉长。

examples.en: He shot from outside the box and scored.
Shoot when you see the chance!

mnemonic.tip: 射门、投篮、拍照都是 shoot——瞄准目标出手。

examples.en: The whole team ran back to defend.
The champion will defend her title next month.

mnemonic.tip: de(去)+fend(打击)→挡开打击→防守。

examples.en: The team attacked from the first minute.
examples.zh: 球队从第一分钟就发起进攻。

examples.en: They attacked down the left side.

mnemonic.tip: attack 谐音"啊他磕"——冲上去跟对手硬磕→进攻。

examples.en: The defender chased the striker all the way back.
The dog loves chasing the ball.

mnemonic.tip: chase 谐音"追死"——追到底不放弃。

examples.en: He slipped on the wet floor and fell.
The ball slipped out of the keeper’s hands.

mnemonic.tip: slip 音轻脚滑——"哧溜"一下就滑倒。

examples.en: His shirt was wet with sweat after the game.
examples.zh: 赛后他的球衣被汗湿透。

examples.en: No sweat, no success.

mnemonic.tip: sweat 与 sweet 一字之差——汗水是甜的果实。

examples.en: Take a deep breath before the race.
He was out of breath after the sprint.
examples.zh: 冲刺后他上气不接下气。

mnemonic.tip: breath 名词，breathe 动词——多个 e 才能"呼"出来。

examples.en: The cheetah runs at an amazing speed.
Slow down—watch your speed on the hill.

mnemonic.tip: speed up 加速，at full speed 全速——速度就是 speed。

examples.en: She won bronze in the 200 metres.
examples.zh: 她在200米比赛中获得铜牌。

examples.en: The statue is made of bronze.

mnemonic.tip: 奖牌三色：gold 金、silver 银、bronze 铜。

examples.en: Grandma is still very active at eighty.
examples.zh: 奶奶八十岁了还很活跃。

examples.en: Try to stay active every day.

mnemonic.tip: act(行动)+ive→爱行动的→活跃的。

examples.en: The puppy is playful and energetic.
examples.zh: 小狗又爱玩又精力充沛。

examples.en: You need to be energetic to keep up with the class.
examples.zh: 要精力充沛才能跟上大家的节奏。

mnemonic.tip: energy(能量)+etic→充满能量的。

examples.en: A fair game needs a good referee.
examples.zh: 公平的比赛需要好裁判。

examples.en: It’s not fair to change the rules now.

mnemonic.tip: fair play 公平竞赛——fair 也指集市、金发。

examples.en: The penalty decision felt unfair to the visitors.
examples.zh: 这个点球判罚对客队来说不公平。

examples.en: It is unfair to blame one player for the loss.
examples.zh: 把失利怪到一名球员头上不公平。

mnemonic.tip: un(不)+fair(公平)→不公平的。

examples.en: My sister is the sporty one in our family.
examples.zh: 我姐姐是我们家最爱运动的。

examples.en: He looks sporty in his running clothes.
examples.zh: 他穿着跑步装显得很有运动范儿。

mnemonic.tip: sport(运动)+y→运动型的。

examples.en: Regular exercise keeps your heart healthy.
He is a regular player in the first team.

mnemonic.tip: regul(规则)+ar→按规则来的→规律的。
